about: A published place names no published place to measure the instrument over, since it is one; it says so by its publish/bootstrap line. Inside it the instrument is its code, and bound says that once. A lock that names neither a published place nor itself as one still refuses, and a lock that names one still measures it or refuses.

cases.name: the published place 0.2.0, folded from inside with no measure asked
cases.said: EXTENSION <code> is its code · a published place names none to measure it over

cases.name: a lock that names no published place and publishes none
cases.said: REFUSE·extension … the lock names no published place to measure it over, and is not one itself

red was: every published folder refused to fold itself once a missing extension became a refusal
